stories.title: UW, Harborview staff walk out to protest alleged offer of 0% raises
stories.summary: The union stated that bargaining is at an impasse, but the university said negotiations are continuing in good faith.

stories.title: Douglas County sheriff links fireworks to deadly Chelan Hills Fire; five charged, one suspect sought
stories.summary: Newly released evidence by the Douglas County Sheriff's Office reveals the investigative process leading to the arrests of five people.

stories.title: King County advances plan to replace Seattle's Route 7 with faster RapidRide service, but some bus stops could disappear
stories.summary: The proposed RapidRide R Line promises shorter trips along Rainier Avenue, though some passengers could face longer walks to catch the bus.

stories.title: Washington state health officials urge vaccination after U.S. loses measles elimination status
stories.summary: The U.S. has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, prompting West Coast states, including Washington, to urge vaccinations amidst rising cases.

stories.title: No car, no address: Barriers keep some Renton families from getting food
stories.summary: Communities In Schools helps families overcome transportation and documentation barriers to food assistance, with support from Northwest Harvest.

stories.title: Grieving parents want ‘gas station heroin’ banned after teen’s death
stories.summary: A 17-year-old died after taking synthetic kratom. His parents want Edmonds to ban all kratom sales.

stories.title: Man, 23, accused of driving nearly 120 mph before deadly crash on I-5
stories.summary: A 23-year-old man from Auburn is facing multiple charges, including vehicular homicide, after allegedly driving 120 mph and crashing into several cars on Nov. 12.

stories.title: Voters approve $420M bond to restore 10 South County fire stations, add 4 more
stories.summary: A study found that seven of the stations would become inoperable in major earthquake.

stories.title: Seattle police seek man accused of hate crime after pulling off woman’s hijab on Capitol Hill
stories.summary: A man told the woman “You should not be wearing that” as he pulled off her hijab, according to Seattle police.

stories.title: I-5 express lanes in Seattle reopen after emergency repairs
stories.summary: Express lanes of Interstate 5 and all express lane ramps have reopened after crews made emergency repairs, according to WSDOT.

stories.title: Kitsap County Airbnb owner accused of bear-spraying guests, threatening them with replica gun
stories.summary: Deputies say the owner threw an Airsoft pistol into a shrub beneath a deck before surrendering at the Silverdale rental.

stories.title: Tacoma immigration attorney sues over H1-B delay keeping her from defending immigrants
stories.summary: A Seattle University law graduate cannot begin her planned job defending detained immigrants, according to a federal lawsuit.
